Class GameConstants

java.lang.Object
GameConstants
public class GameConstants extends Object
Global simulation tunables shared by the engine, world, and organisms.

Holds canvas size, frame timing, calendar length, and runtime flags such as headless mode. Values are read throughout the simulation; CurrentFrame and headless are mutated by the game loop and entry point.
